pr_summary: Fix uninitialized text property in Conditional class causing typed error when getText() is called on a Conditional object without explicitly set text. The fix initializes the private string $text property to empty string.
special_system_dependencies: PHP extensions: ctype, dom, gd, iconv, fileinfo, libxml, mbstring, simplexml, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, zip, zlib
test_file_cues: tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests/Style/ConditionalFormatting/PR3946Test.php - tests Conditional with CONTAINSTEXT type and Xlsx writer output
platform_constraint_evidence: No Windows-only or macOS-only dependencies detected
PHP with Composer is cross-platform and works on Linux
notes: PHPSpreadsheet is a pure PHP library for reading/writing spreadsheet files. The CI runs on Ubuntu with PHP 8.0-8.3. Test requires vendor/bin/phpunit. The fix is a simple property initialization in Conditional.php.
